views.definition:
SELECT id,
    name,
    account_id,
    seller_id,
    created_by,
    status,
    daily_limit,
    timezone,
    start_hour,
    end_hour,
    subject,
    body,
    steps,
    batch_id,
    created_at,
    template_id,
    template_version,
    requires_application,
    asset_snapshot,
    body_format,
    excluded_contact_ids,
    ( SELECT (count(*))::integer AS count
           FROM public.campaign_enrollments e
          WHERE (e.campaign_id = c.id)) AS audience_count,
    public.campaign_delivery_stats(id) AS delivery_stats,
    first_contact,
    selected_contact_ids,
    scheduled_at,
    activated_at,
    brand_snapshot
   FROM public.campaigns c;
